topic: Why do leaves change colour in autumn?

claims.claim: Chlorophyll gives leaves their green colour.
claims.passage: Chlorophyll gives leaves their green colour.

claims.claim: As leaves prepare to fall, chlorophyll breaks down, revealing yellow and orange carotenoids already present.
claims.passage: As leaves prepare to fall, chlorophyll breaks down, revealing yellow and orange carotenoids already present.

claims.claim: Some trees also produce red anthocyanins during autumn.
